display_name: Superior Attuned Superior Might of the Tanker C
help: UNIQUE -- No more than 1 enhancement of this type may be slotted by a character. Enhances the accuracy of a power by {Boost.Attrib.Accuracy.Scale}% and damage by {Boost.Attrib.Damage.Scale}% and reduces recharge time by {Boost.Attrib.RechargeTime.Scale}% . This enhancement can only be slotted by Tankers and may be slotted into any Tanker damage power.
short_help: Set: Superior Might of the Tanker
power_display_names: Superior Might of the Tanker: Accuracy/Damage/Recharge
power_short_helps: Enhances Accuracy, Damage and Increases Attack Rate
